Tested locally, it works as expected.

### Before

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bfc93f1e-463c-421e-a741-ce41aa04bb29

### After

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/717f7d85-30bf-441f-acb2-49c278a6ef7d

However, I'm not sure if the hover feedback is ideal here. We want the hovered handle to be *more* visible than other handles, not less visible. Also, the general logic in Godot is to brighten UI elements that are hovered (or make them more opaque).

I would reverse the logic so that non-hovered handles have an opacity of `0.75`, and hovered handles have an opacity of `1.0`.

In the future, we'll also want specific handles to have a lower opacity than others based on the normal they're representing (for example, faces pointing away from the viewer for a CSGBox3D). This is significantly more complex though, so that should be left to its own PR.
